description.text:
A high-class pack released on 6 December 2024, led by Eevee ex of the Stellar Tera Type and its eight evolutions as Pokémon ex: Eevee ex's Ability lets it evolve into any Pokémon that evolves from Eevee. It also gathered strong cards that did well at events, some in new illustrations, among them Teal Mask Ogerpon ex, Iron Valiant ex, Roaring Moon ex, Pecharunt ex, Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex, Terapagos ex and Dragapult ex, with new cards such as Hoothoot, Larry's Skill and the ACE SPEC cards Max Rod and Treasure Tracker. Each pack held ten cards, one of them a Pokémon ex. The cards are numbered to 187, followed by full-art Super Rare Supporters, Special Art Rare cards of Pokémon ex and Supporters, and Ultra Rare Iron Leaves ex, Teal Mask Ogerpon ex, Walking Wake ex, Pikachu ex and Terapagos ex drawn as line art on gold. In English many of its cards came out in Prismatic Evolutions in January 2025.

Beside the ordinary cards, Terastal Festival ex holds premium mirror versions with special finishes, patterned with Poké Balls or, more rarely, Master Balls. Its Special Art Rare cards show Iron Hands ex, Iron Valiant ex, Iron Crown ex, Sandy Shocks ex, Roaring Moon ex and Raging Bolt ex in a style unlike their earlier cards.
